quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Hot"? (a steamy mug of cocoa vs. a snowy winter day)
quests.question: Hot
quests.hint: Think about how ice cream feels the moment it comes out of the freezer. What's the opposite of "Hot"?
quests.explanation: "Hot" means very warm. "Cold" means very chilly. Since those are completely different, Cold is the opposite of Hot!
quests.funFact: Cold is actually just the complete absence of heat energy.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Big"? (a huge elephant vs. a tiny ladybug)
quests.question: Big
quests.hint: Think about how a mouse looks standing next to an elephant. What's the opposite of "Big"?
quests.explanation: "Big" means large in size, taking up a lot of space. "Small" means little in size, taking up very little space. Since those are completely different, Small is the opposite of Big!
quests.funFact: Something small takes up very little physical space.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Up"? (a balloon floating toward the sky vs. a leaf falling to the ground)
quests.question: Up
quests.hint: Think about what happens the moment you let go of a ball. What's the opposite of "Up"?
quests.explanation: "Up" means moving toward the sky. "Down" means moving toward the ground. Since those are completely different, Down is the opposite of Up!
quests.funFact: Gravity is the invisible force that constantly pulls everything down.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Left"? (raising your left hand vs. raising your right hand)
quests.question: Left
quests.hint: Think about which hand most people wave with. What's the opposite of "Left"?
quests.explanation: "Left" means the side where your heart is. "Right" means the side most people write with. Since those are completely different, Right is the opposite of Left!
quests.funFact: The right side of your brain actually controls the left side of your body.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Open"? (a door standing wide open vs. a door closed up tight)
quests.question: Open
quests.hint: Think about what you do to a storybook the moment you finish it. What's the opposite of "Open"?
quests.explanation: "Open" means not blocking the way through. "Shut" means closed so nothing can pass. Since those are completely different, Shut is the opposite of Open!
quests.funFact: Shutting a door completely stops the wind from blowing inside.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Fast"? (a cheetah racing past vs. a snail inching along)
quests.question: Fast
quests.hint: Think about how a turtle moves compared to a race car. What's the opposite of "Fast"?
quests.explanation: "Fast" means moving with great speed. "Slow" means moving with very little speed. Since those are completely different, Slow is the opposite of Fast!
quests.funFact: A sloth is famous for being one of the slowest animals on Earth.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Good"? (a gold star on your homework vs. a spilled bowl of cereal)
quests.question: Good
quests.hint: Think about how you would describe sharing your toys with a friend. What's the opposite of "Good"?
quests.explanation: "Good" means kind, or done really well. "Bad" means unkind, or done poorly. Since those are completely different, Bad is the opposite of Good!
quests.funFact: Something bad has a negative effect on you or your surroundings.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "First"? (the winner crossing the finish line vs. the final runner arriving)
quests.question: First
quests.hint: Think about who gets the gold medal in a race. What's the opposite of "First"?
quests.explanation: "First" means the one that comes before all the others. "Last" means the one that comes after all the others. Since those are completely different, Last is the opposite of First!
quests.funFact: The last person in a line has to wait the longest.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Tall"? (a giraffe reaching the treetops vs. a mouse by the floor)
quests.question: Tall
quests.hint: Think about who could grab the top shelf without a step stool. What's the opposite of "Tall"?
quests.explanation: "Tall" means reaching up very high. "Short" means not reaching up very far. Since those are completely different, Short is the opposite of Tall!
quests.funFact: A short pencil is much harder to hold than a long one.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Front"? (the front of a line vs. the very back of the same line)
quests.question: Front
quests.hint: Think about where the driver sits in a car compared to the trunk. What's the opposite of "Front"?
quests.explanation: "Front" means the part that faces forward. "Back" means the part that faces backward. Since those are completely different, Back is the opposite of Front!
quests.funFact: Your spine is a stack of bones running straight down your back.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Wide"? (a wide six-lane highway vs. a narrow path through the woods)
quests.question: Wide
quests.hint: Think about which road has room for more cars side by side. What's the opposite of "Wide"?
quests.explanation: "Wide" means stretching far from side to side. "Narrow" means only a small space from side to side. Since those are completely different, Narrow is the opposite of Wide!
quests.funFact: A narrow path only has enough room for one person to walk.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Clean"? (a freshly bathed puppy vs. a puppy covered in mud)
quests.question: Clean
quests.hint: Think about how your hands look after playing outside all afternoon. What's the opposite of "Clean"?
quests.explanation: "Clean" means washed and free of mess. "Dirty" means covered in mud or grime. Since those are completely different, Dirty is the opposite of Clean!
quests.funFact: Dirty hands carry invisible germs that can make you sick.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Giant"? (a towering giant from a story vs. a tiny mouse in the corner)
quests.question: Giant
quests.hint: Think about the size difference between a whale and a goldfish. What's the opposite of "Giant"?
quests.explanation: "Giant" means enormous, much bigger than normal. "Tiny" means extremely small, much smaller than normal. Since those are completely different, Tiny is the opposite of Giant!
quests.funFact: A tiny ant can carry food much heavier than its own body.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Day"? (a bright sunny afternoon vs. a dark sky full of stars)
quests.question: Day
quests.hint: Think about what you see out your window right before bedtime. What's the opposite of "Day"?
quests.explanation: "Day" means when the sun is shining. "Night" means when the moon and stars are out. Since those are completely different, Night is the opposite of Day!
quests.funFact: Night happens when your side of the Earth faces completely away from the sun.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Hard"? (a solid gray rock vs. a fluffy teddy bear)
quests.question: Hard
quests.hint: Think about which one you would rather hug, a stone or a pillow. What's the opposite of "Hard"?
quests.explanation: "Hard" means firm, and it does not squish. "Soft" means squishy and easy to press down. Since those are completely different, Soft is the opposite of Hard!
quests.funFact: Soft things gently yield when you press against them.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Near"? (a friend standing right beside you vs. a mountain way off in the distance)
quests.question: Near
quests.hint: Think about the huge distance between your house and the moon. What's the opposite of "Near"?
quests.explanation: "Near" means close by, not far away. "Far" means a long way away. Since those are completely different, Far is the opposite of Near!
quests.funFact: The sun is so far away that its light takes 8 minutes to reach us.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Big"? (a huge elephant vs. a tiny ladybug)
quests.question: Big
quests.hint: Here's a clue: how a mouse looks standing next to an elephant. That describes the exact opposite of "Big"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: big means large in size, taking up a lot of space, and small means little in size, taking up very little space — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: The smallest bone in the human body is inside your ear.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Loud"? (a roaring rocket launch vs. a softly whispered secret)
quests.question: Loud
quests.hint: Think about how a library sounds compared to a fireworks show. What's the opposite of "Loud"?
quests.explanation: "Loud" means making a big, noticeable sound. "Quiet" means making almost no sound at all. Since those are completely different, Quiet is the opposite of Loud!
quests.funFact: A quiet room helps your brain focus entirely on reading or studying.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Awake"? (wide eyes at breakfast vs. soft snoring under a blanket)
quests.question: Awake
quests.hint: Think about how you look at midnight compared to how you look at breakfast. What's the opposite of "Awake"?
quests.explanation: "Awake" means with your eyes open and alert. "Asleep" means resting deeply with your eyes closed. Since those are completely different, Asleep is the opposite of Awake!
quests.funFact: When you are asleep, your body is busy repairing your tired muscles.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "In"? (a cat curled up inside a box vs. a cat playing outside it)
quests.question: In
quests.hint: Think about where your toys go when you tidy them away. What's the opposite of "In"?
quests.explanation: "In" means on the inside of something. "Out" means on the outside of something. Since those are completely different, Out is the opposite of In!
quests.funFact: Walking out of a dark room into the sun makes your eyes squint.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "On"? (a lamp glowing in a dark room vs. that same lamp gone dark)
quests.question: On
quests.hint: Think about what a light switch does when you flip it downward. What's the opposite of "On"?
quests.explanation: "On" means switched so it is working. "Off" means switched so it stops working. Since those are completely different, Off is the opposite of On!
quests.funFact: Turning off the lights when you leave a room saves a lot of electricity.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Thick"? (a giant thick dictionary vs. a thin little pamphlet)
quests.question: Thick
quests.hint: Think about which book takes longer to read all the way through. What's the opposite of "Thick"?
quests.explanation: "Thick" means taking up a lot of space front to back. "Thin" means taking up very little space front to back. Since those are completely different, Thin is the opposite of Thick!
quests.funFact: A thin sheet of ice on a lake is extremely dangerous to walk on.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Clean"? (a freshly bathed puppy vs. a puppy covered in mud)
quests.question: Clean
quests.hint: Here's a clue: how your hands look after playing outside all afternoon. That describes the exact opposite of "Clean"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: clean means washed and free of mess, and dirty means covered in mud or grime — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Pigs often roll in dirty mud to cool down their skin in the summer.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Top"? (the top of a tall mountain vs. the bottom of the deep sea)
quests.question: Top
quests.hint: Think about where the cherry sits on a sundae compared to the bowl underneath. What's the opposite of "Top"?
quests.explanation: "Top" means the highest part of something. "Bottom" means the lowest part of something. Since those are completely different, Bottom is the opposite of Top!
quests.funFact: The bottom of the ocean is completely dark and incredibly cold.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "High"? (a kite soaring in the sky vs. a worm down on the ground)
quests.question: High
quests.hint: Think about where an airplane flies compared to where an ant crawls. What's the opposite of "High"?
quests.explanation: "High" means far above the ground. "Low" means close to the ground. Since those are completely different, Low is the opposite of High!
quests.funFact: A low sound has a deep pitch, like the roar of a large lion.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Full"? (a cup filled to the top vs. a cup with nothing inside)
quests.question: Full
quests.hint: Think about how your plate looks right after dinner, not right before. What's the opposite of "Full"?
quests.explanation: "Full" means holding as much as it can. "Empty" means holding nothing at all. Since those are completely different, Empty is the opposite of Full!
quests.funFact: An empty room echoes loudly when you speak inside it.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Wet"? (a puddle after the rain vs. sand baking in the sun)
quests.question: Wet
quests.hint: Think about how a towel feels right after a swim at the pool. What's the opposite of "Wet"?
quests.explanation: "Wet" means covered in water. "Dry" means with no water on it at all. Since those are completely different, Dry is the opposite of Wet!
quests.funFact: A desert is a dry place that gets almost zero rain every year.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Happy"? (a child laughing with a big grin vs. a child with teary eyes)
quests.question: Happy
quests.hint: Think about how you might feel if you lost your favorite toy. What's the opposite of "Happy"?
quests.explanation: "Happy" means feeling joyful and smiling. "Sad" means feeling upset, like you want to cry. Since those are completely different, Sad is the opposite of Happy!
quests.funFact: Crying when you are sad actually releases stress chemicals from your body.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Push"? (pushing a shopping cart forward vs. pulling a wagon behind you)
quests.question: Push
quests.hint: Think about what you do to a drawer to close it instead of open it. What's the opposite of "Push"?
quests.explanation: "Push" means moving something away from you. "Pull" means moving something toward you. Since those are completely different, Pull is the opposite of Push!
quests.funFact: Gravity is a force that constantly pulls you down toward the Earth.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Heavy"? (a big gray rock vs. a fluffy little feather)
quests.question: Heavy
quests.hint: Think about which one drifts down slowly when you drop it, a feather or a rock. What's the opposite of "Heavy"?
quests.explanation: "Heavy" means hard to lift because it weighs a lot. "Light" means easy to lift because it weighs very little. Since those are completely different, Light is the opposite of Heavy!
quests.funFact: Light travels faster than absolutely anything else in the entire universe.
